headline: iPhone 18 Pro Max SOS-mode bug on AT&T traced to hardware issue
summary: Some iPhone 18 Pro Max units on AT&T are stuck in SOS mode and unable to call or text. AT&T initially told affected users to update their software immediately, but Apple has since confirmed a hardware issue is behind the bug, and phones that updates cannot fix will need to be replaced.
